name: TB OTD - Store revenue (hello Dataflow)
description: Batch job: reads a CSV of orders (order_id,store_id,amount) and writes revenue per store as one CSV file.

parameters.name: input
parameters.label: Orders CSV
parameters.helpText: gs:// path of the orders CSV, e.g. gs://my-bucket/hello/input/orders-sample.csv

parameters.name: output
parameters.label: Output prefix
parameters.helpText: gs:// prefix for the result; .csv is appended, e.g. gs://my-bucket/hello/output/run1/store-revenue
